supporting_observations.claim: At 13:44:42 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1 from WS-ICHEN-01 under ivy.chen. The associated proxy tunnel and Zeek connection are also recorded, but the available records do not show the script contents or whether it was executed.

About 1 minute 40 seconds after that request, WS-ICHEN-01 established an SMB connection to DC-NWD-01 on port 445. The DC recorded a network logon for the WS-ICHEN-01$ computer account; these records do not attribute the SMB activity to ivy.chen or establish what was accessed.

The available records show Google Drive File Stream starting and browser access to Google Drive, including the shared-with-me page. The inventory lists Microsoft 365 / OneDrive as approved, but these records do not establish that files were uploaded, downloaded, or otherwise transferred.

Before the reported PowerShell-window time, ivy.chen's workstation ran a command enumerating the contents of a network share and created a temporary file. These events are at 13:22 UTC and do not establish a connection to the later script request or SMB activity.

The script request followed by an SMB connection to the domain controller is suspicious in light of the stated practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-SOKAFOR-01. The records do not establish that the script caused the SMB connection or that either action was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that winsec and Sysmon were not collected on WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage. This includes the reported 13:40 time; the limitation is stated in the coverage metadata, which has no record ID.
The proxy and Zeek records show connections and some request metadata, but the supplied evidence does not include the contents of u.ps1 or establish its execution.
The observed SMB session is associated with the workstation computer account in the DC logon record; the supplied records do not identify the interactive user or process responsible.
claims_not_established: Whether a PowerShell process appeared or ran on WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40 UTC.
Whether u.ps1 was executed, what it contained, who authored or approved it, or whether it caused subsequent activity.
What the SMB session to DC-NWD-01 accessed or whether it involved remote administration, execution, or an ordinary system operation.
Whether ivy.chen uploaded, downloaded, or transferred files through Google Drive.
Whether any data was exfiltrated, credentials were compromised, or persistence or privilege escalation occurred.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover any available endpoint process, PowerShell operational/script-block, command-line, and EDR telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC.
Obtain the full proxy request/response details and the exact contents, hash, repository provenance, and approval status of u.ps1.
Review DC-NWD-01 and relevant share audit logs for the SMB session, including accessed paths, operations, and any remote execution evidence.
Review Google Drive audit or endpoint file-transfer records to determine whether files were transferred.
Confirm with ivy.chen and IT whether the script request, share activity, or domain-controller access was authorized.
